description: This source file implements the PlatformVideoFramePool class, which manages a pool of VideoFrame objects for efficient reuse in media processing on ChromeOS. It includes functions for initializing the pool, acquiring and releasing frames, and handling frame layout and format consistency.

classes.name: PlatformVideoFramePool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of reusable VideoFrame objects for efficient media processing on ChromeOS.

methods.name: DefaultCreateFrame
methods.description: Creates a new VideoFrame with specified parameters, handling protected and linear buffer options.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::GetFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a VideoFrame from the pool, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the frame pool with specified format, size, and other parameters.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::UnwrapFrame
methods.description: Returns the underlying VideoFrame associated with a wrapped frame.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::NotifyWhenFrameAvailable
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked when a frame becomes available.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::ReleaseAllFrames
methods.description: Releases all frames in the pool, clearing resources.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::GetGpuBufferLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout of GPU buffers used in the pool.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool::OnFrameReleased
methods.description: Handles the release of a frame back into the pool.
